newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cuts internal coffee price by 0.55 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cuts internal coffee price by 0.55 pct.

text.p: Colombia cut its internal coffee price by another 0.55 percent Friday, setting it at 378,375 pesos per 125-kg load, the National Coffee Growers' Federation said.
It was the sixth price cut since Jan. 31, when a new sliding- scale formula was introduced to adjust prices paid to growers on a weekly basis and allow them to better track world market prices.

The latest drop in the internal price follows last week's 3.27 percent cut and a steep 11.6 percent cut the week before that. A federation spokesman said it was based on Friday's low $2.23 per pound trading price for Colombian coffee in New York.
